title: About
text:
Personal
I am Alvaro Gavilán-Rojas, a civil structural engineer (2021) born in 1995 in Asunción, Paraguay. I live in Rennes, France, where I did my PhD (2025) in computational mechanics. I started this personal website to share posts about:

Solid and structural mechanics
Structural engineering
Scientific programming with Julia
Producing nice reproducible documents with Julia and Quarto

I have a YouTube channel where I also upload content on these topics and guitar music.
In the past, I developed an extensive 25 hour long course in spanish on SMath Studio.


Website
I develop and maintain the code for this website using Quarto. Hosting is provided by Github Pages and DNS is provided by Squarespace.
